title: Wɔn a Wɔayi Wɔn a Wɔayi Wɔn Ma
intro: Wɔ abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu no, ɔsoro abɔfo nantew adesamma mu, na wɔn a wɔbɛn wɔn paa no bi antumi anhu hann no. Saa kyerɛwtohɔ yi di akra mmienu a bɛn a wɔbɛn nkɔmhyɛni no bɛyɛɛ wɔn sɔhwɛ, na wɔn agyapadeɛ yɛɛ asuadeɛ a ɛnkyɛre.
clues: Yɛtraa ase wɔ adiyifo akɛse bere mu, nanso yɛn ani kɔɔ so yɛɛ den wɔ nokware a wɔde bae no ho.
Ɔsoro adiyisɛm hyɛɛ yɛn afie ma, nanso na yɛn akoma pirim.
Ná yɛware mmarima a wɔpaw wɔn sɛ wɔmmmɔ wɔn nkurɔfo kɔkɔ.
Bere a asotwe bae no, yɛanhwehwɛ guankɔbea wɔ adaka no mu na yɛanguan osu a ɛredɛw no, efisɛ yedii kɔkɔbɔ ahorow no ho fɛw.
Wɔaka yɛn ho asɛm wɔ Kur’aan mu sɛ nhwɛsoɔ ma wɔn a wɔnnye nni, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den mpo ne nkɔmhyɛni bi nnye nkwa.
Yɛyɛ Nuh ne Lut yerenom a woyii wɔn mae na wɔnam saayɛ so buu wɔn fɔ.

trial.label: Dɛn ne wɔn sɔhwɛ?
options: Na wɔwaree adiyifoɔ nanso wɔannye nni
Na wɔyɛ obonin na wɔde asodi no too adiyifo no so
Ná wɔyɛ adefo na wɔyɛ ahantan
Iblis sɔɔ wɔn hwɛe sɛ wobefi wɔn afie mu
trial.answer: Na wɔwaree adiyifoɔ nanso wɔannye nni

location.label: Dɛn na na wɔn nkrabea wɔ abusuabɔ?

outcome.label: Dɛn ne wɔn awiei?
options: Wonu wɔn ho na wɔgyee wɔn nkwa
Wogyaw wɔn a na wonni mma
Wɔde wɔn kɔɔ nnommumfa mu daa
Wɔdanee wɔn bɛyɛɛ bonsu ne mprako

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
